notes.title: New Game Judero is OUT NOW
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27758768/1bff930460da809fe9107ac350ce410f7d979b3c.png[/img]
Judero is an action/ adventure game inspired by the rich folk history of the Scottish Borders. You play as Judero, a Celt who can establish a rapport with the nature around him. Travel with Judero through a handcrafted landscape as he discovers there is an evil at work manipulating the unguarded.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1960900/Judero/

notes.title: New Kayabros Game Out Now!
notes.notes:
A psychedelic hack and slash game about an immigrant who has to take drugs to do her job. Play as Anna, finding a job and moving to a new country. Explore her new life, struggles, loneliness, relationships, language barrier.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1765560/Pill_Baby/]Check out Pill Baby on Steam[/url]

notes.title: Celebrating 5 Year Anniversary and Pill Baby
notes.notes:
5 years ago we released Soul Searching. We are grateful for your support for this humble little emotional journey.

We are doing a 90% off sale to celebrate the occasion. The cheapest the game has ever been. This kind of sale only cames once every 5 years!

If you saw our latest news, we got Soul Searching tested on SteamDeck, and we are happy to say it works great!

Now for our biggest news... We have a new game!! It's ALMOST out. Wishlist now and be ready to hear the news next month!

It's called Pill Baby. And it's a stylish hack and slash game about an immigrant who takes drugs to be able to work. Check it out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1765560/Pill_Baby/

notes.title: Ready for SteamDeck!
notes.notes: Thanks to the kindness of strangers we were able to get Soul Searching tested on SteamDeck, and it runs great! More details here: https://twitter.com/kayabros/status/1484177238790524934

notes.title: Update: V1.03 - Quality Setting, Bug Fixes, Linux Gamepad Support
notes.notes:
Hello! A new update is now live. Here are the patch notes.
[list]
    [*]Quality setting is available in the graphics options menu. If you set it to low, the game will work better on low-spec machines.
    [*]Corrected some misspelled words.
    [*]Gamepad is now supported in Linux.
    [*]Gamepad doesn't make mouse cursor invisible in multiplayer.
    [*]Infinite zoom bug is fixed.
    [*]Other small bug fixes.
[/list]
Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Update: V1.02 - Bug Fixes, Enhancements
notes.notes:
Hello there, a new update is now live.
[list]
    [*]Enhancements on the Turkish font (Türkçe fontta düzeltmeler yapıldı)
    [*]Now it's easier to close map with mouse
    [*]Sometimes, when you faint, you would wake up as another person with magic skills you weren't supposed to know. Happens to the best of us. This is now fixed.
    [*]Now you don't have infinite water in your bucket while it's raining.
    [*]This one is embarrassing. On the last update, I created a bug so that when you buy a boat, you would keep your old boat. This is now fixed.
    [*]Volume sliders sometimes weren't saved. Fixed.
[/list]
Thank you so much for your positive reviews and encouraging comments. I'll keep working on this game, and try to give you lovely people the best experience you can get out of it.

notes.title: Update: V1.01 - Trading Cards, Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Trading cards added! Collect the cards, gain the Soul Searcher badge, have customized profile backgrounds, emotes.

Bug fixes:
[list]
    [*]No infinite loop when you try to delete a save slot now
    [*]You can use ladders on boats more freely now so you can't get stuck with other objects in sea.
    [*]Starting a game only to see the boats won't move is now fixed.
    [*]Some green visitor now won't be a problem to talk to. (nonspoiler-y patch notes ftw)
    [*]Other small fixes.
[/list]
